Summary: [ADM-WEEK5] Tích hợp Data-driven Testing từ design_testcase_adm.csv vào CodeceptJS cho Module Admin
Description:
h2. 1. User Story
As a QA Tester, I want to upgrade the CodeceptJS automated test suite for the Admin module (/add_movie.php, /manage_movies.php, /orders.php, /customers.php, /statistics.php) to dynamically read test data from design_testcase_adm.csv so that test coverage is verified across boundary and authorization rules without hardcoded values.

h2. 2. Context & Scope
- Sync latest changes from main branch into ADM_Blackbox.
- Implement csv-parse to iterate through all 13 test cases in design_testcase_adm.csv.
- Verify Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), and unauthorized session redirects.

h2. 3. Acceptance Criteria (AC)
- [AC1] Pull latest code from main into ADM_Blackbox cleanly.
- [AC2] CodeceptJS dynamically executes all 13 test scenarios from design_testcase_adm.csv without hardcoding.
- [AC3] All tests pass 100% and unauthorized access is safely redirected to login without Fatal error.
- [AC4] Commit message includes Jira task key to link development status on Jira.

h2. 4. Definition of Done (DoD)
- tests/admin_management_test.js updated with csv-parse.
- npx codeceptjs run passes 13/13 scenarios.
- Code committed and pushed to ADM_Blackbox.
